thread:
jess: FYI invoice INV-7890 shows a prorated reserved commit line (3/30 days). Customer says commit was active full month. Can someone sanity-check?

tom: do we have the usage tags and start/end timestamps for the commit? sounds like a partial-month proration.

eric: pulling metering now. initial glance: there was a failover on 2432060000 that routed some traffic to a different nodepool — could explain split. pinging infra for logs.

billing-bot: Usage upload completed: /artifacts/usage/INV-7890-2026-11.csv (checksum OK) :package:

clare: customer (Symmetry Labs) says they never requested a commit change. contract shows reserved commit effective 2026-11-01.

jess: Contract start is 2026-11-01, signed 2026-10-25. So proration shouldn't apply. The invoice line is: `Reserved commit - Nov - $14,400 prorated 3/30`

tom: possible causes: 1) agent created a short-lived auxiliary commit for failover, 2) our billing job merged two buckets with different tags. Can you paste the invoice JSON snippet?

eric: invoice snippet from billing export: `{"customer":"SYM","period":"2026-11","line_items":[{"type":"reserved_commit","quantity":960,"prorate_days":3,"days_in_period":30,"amount":14400}]}`

clare: that `prorate_days` looks wrong. Tagging @tom for metering audit and @jess for customer comms.

jess: I'll tell the AE to expect a reissued invoice or credit. Prefer reissue if it's a pure metering bug.

eric: confirmed — the meter backfill job accidentally split the commit into two tags for the first three days (failover window). We'll re-run reconciliation to merge buckets.

tom: action items: (1) reconciliation rerun by infra (eric) (2) provisional credit for customer pending run (jess/finance) (3) reissue invoice if reconciliation removes prorate (billing team).

jess: conservative approach: issue provisional credit of $14,400 as a hold so customer isn't blocked on their PO. Finance, ok to approve provisional? :thinking:

clare: ok from my side to approve provisional credit up to that amount, will need GL memo and follow-up once final.

eric: started reconciliation run at 2432109000, ETA ~20m. I'll post results.

tom: if reconciliation clears, billing ops — please reissue invoice INV-7890 with corrected reserved_commit line and mark original as superseded.

jess: I'll update Symmetry Labs and let them know we expect to reissue within the hour, offering provisional credit until then. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
